protectedReason: Validate ownership at the atomic effect/checkpoint boundary, rejecting both writes together for revoked epochs.
openSetPolicy: Unexpected findings are pending adjudication, not automatically false positives. Record supplied evidence and a bounded reproducer; confirm, reject, or leave unresolved without silently changing the frozen inventory. Apply decisions uniformly across arms and publish sensitivity.
matchingPolicy: Match independent causal issues one-to-one; duplicate prose does not earn recall. Accept any valid visible-input witness, not an exact driver trace or phrase.
independence: Public synthetic same-workflow authorship; no independent human review.
